mainEntity.name: How much does artificial grass installation cost in Gauteng?

acceptedAnswer.text: Artificial grass installation in Gauteng typically ranges from R200 to R600+ per square metre, depending on the quality of turf selected, surface preparation required, and project size. PrimeTurf provides free site consultations and itemised quotations for every project. Contact us on 076 804 8868 for a no-obligation quote.

PrimeTurf offers an 8-year manufacturer's warranty on all turf products and a 24-month installation guarantee covering all workmanship. Warranty documentation is provided at the final project walkthrough.

mainEntity.name: Which areas in Gauteng does PrimeTurf service?

acceptedAnswer.text: PrimeTurf services all of Gauteng province, including Pretoria East, Waterkloof Ridge, Silverlakes, Sandton, Midrand, Centurion, Fourways, Menlyn, Faerie Glen, Steyn City, Woodhill, Mooikloof, and all surrounding areas. We also service Cape Town.

mainEntity.name: Is artificial grass pet-friendly and safe for children?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All PrimeTurf products are non-toxic, pet-friendly, and safe for children. Our turf systems include permeable backing for drainage and are manufactured without harmful chemicals.

mainEntity.name: How long does artificial grass installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most residential installations are completed within 1–3 days. Larger commercial or estate projects may take 3–7 days depending on scope. PrimeTurf follows a four-stage process: consultation, design and quote, site preparation, and final inspection.
